_doc: Texture stage settings for tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_texture.py + s2_paint.py (metres, Blender axes).

sigil._doc: bold glowing ring + vertical bar + radiating rays with white-hot centre lines (width = half-width of the bright line, m; halo = glow band width factor)

spine._doc: back: a glowing crack down the spine from the nape to the belt, branching across both shoulder blades (approved turnaround sheet)

network._doc: lava crack network: domain-warped Voronoi edges (freq per m, warp m) gated into patches (gate on fbm), per region: z range, |x| range, facing, width [near the sigil, far] (half-width m), near_gate (the gate opens toward the sigil), strength
network._doc_halo_w: halo_w: the network's glow band is weaker than the sigil's so the sigil dominates
network._doc_gate: a region's own gate overrides the network gate (the forearms carry more cracks: his identity when he is bare-handed)

cavity._doc: the sculpt's concavity folded into the skin paint (range -> strength toward the shadow tone); glow_range: the deepest chest creases (abs/pec lines) glow

shading._doc: smooth = no sharp edges (organic); others get sharp edges above per_object_deg (default sharp_angle_deg)

hi_lo._doc: tangent normals + cavity + AO from the stage-1 sculpt reference (never shipped) onto the body skin. valid_dist [full, none] (m): texels whose ray hit lies further than that from the low-poly surface fade to flat (the sculpt's hair, beard, skirt and gauntlets are not skin). exclude: regions that take no sculpt detail (the sculpt's forearms and hands are gauntlet rock).

self_ao._doc: Cycles AO of the assembled low-poly parts (distance m)
